business_problem: The Hawaii Department of Commerce and Consumer Affairs (DCCA) serves a vital mission: protecting residents while ensuring a level playing field that promotes fair business competition across the state.
solution_summary: Hawaii Department of Commerce and Consumer Affairs (DCCA) partnered with Google Public Sector to transform resident services and elevate public trust, resolving 42% of inbound calls using an IVR and reaching resident satisfaction scores of ~85% with Gemini Enterprise. Rather than making incremental fixes, DCCA partnered with Google Public Sector to completely reimagine their digital presence and engagement. The department selected Google Cloud for its enterprise-grade search capabilities and integrated, full-stack approach to AI. With Gemini Enterprise , DCCA was able to integrate web search, conversational virtual agents, and contact center modernization into a unified ecosystem that empowers residents and local businesses with intuitive self-service tools.
